item.name: Disposable Fixture Setup
item.description: Creates one run-scoped Pending User, two dedicated SchoolClasses, two dedicated Courses, and one disposable Student. Run after Authentication E2E in the same Newman execution so the Admin session is present. Guard checks Postman variables and localhost URLs only; it cannot inspect the running app process or independently verify its database target. Verify SchoolManagementDb_Test from PowerShell before Newman. Export runtime variables to a separate local environment file to retain fixture_run_id and discovered IDs for review/recovery. No cleanup requests are included.
